verses.text: Aya ni amajambo ya Nehemiya mwene Hakaliya: Mu kwezi kwa Kisilevu mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri, umwami Aritazeruzi ari ku ngoma, nari ku mugwa i Suza.
Hanani, umwe mu bo tuvukana, aza avuye i Buyuda ari kumwe n’abandi bagabo bamwe, maze ndababaza amakuru y’amasigarira y’Abayuda batashe bavuye mu kinyago, n’ivyerekeye Yerusalemu.

Barambwira bati: “Abarokotse mu bari barajanywe ari inyagano, bakaba baragarutse mu ntara y’iwabo i Buyuda, bari mu mibabaro myinshi no mu biteterwe. Uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu rwarasenyutse, kandi n’amarembo yaho yatongojwe umuriro.”
Maze kwumva ivyo, nicara hasi ndarira. Mara imisi ngandaye nisonzesheje kandi nsenga Imana yo mw’ijuru.
Maze ndavuga nti: “Yewe Uhoraho , Mana yo mw’ijuru, Mana nkuru kandi uhambaye, uzigama isezerano ryawe ry’urukundo wagiranye n’abagukunda kandi bubaha amabwirizwa yawe,

ndakwinginze untege ugutwi kandi inyonga zawe ntizive kuri jewe, wumve ugusenga kw’umusavyi wawe ndiko ndasengera imbere yawe ku murango no mw’ijoro nsengera abasavyi bawe ari bo Bisirayeli. Ndatuye ivyaha twebwe Abisirayeli, na jewe ndimwo n’umuryango wa data, twakoze tugucumurako.
Twakoze ibibi vyinshi mu nyonga zawe. Ntitwitondeye ivyo wategetse, amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe vyawe ivyo wahaye umusavyi wawe Mose.
Wibuke ivyo wabwiye umusavyi wawe Mose, uvuga uti: ‘Nimutaba abizigirwa, nzobasanzariza mu yandi mahanga,

ariko nimwangarukako maze mukumvira ivyo nategetse, nanje naho abantu banyu bazoba barasanzaye bagashika ku mpera y’isi, nzobegeranya ndabakureyo ndabagarukane mu kibanza natoranije ngo Izina ryanje abe ari ho riba.’
Ni abasavyi bawe kandi ni ubwoko bwawe, abo wacunguye ukoresheje ubushobozi bwawe n’ukuboko kwawe gukomeye.

Yewe Uhoraho, niwumve ugusenga kw’umusavyi wawe n’ugusenga kw’abasavyi bawe bahimbarwa no kwubaha izina ryawe. Uhe umusavyi wawe kuroranirwa uwu musi ngo aze kugira ikiganza ciza imbere y’uwu muntu.” Nari njejwe guhereza ibinyobwa umwami.
Mu kwezi kwa Nisani mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri umwami Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma, igihe umuvinyu wari imbere yiwe, ndawakira ndawumuhereza. Sinari bwigere mboneka mbabaye ndi imbere yiwe;
ni ho umwami yambaza ati: “Ni kubera iki mu maso hawe hijirirwe kandi utagwaye? Ivyo ntibiva ku kindi atari umubabaro wo mu mutima.” Ngira ubwoba bwinshi cane,

ariko nishura umwami nti: “Uragahora ku ngoma mwami! Mbega noreka kugira umubabaro gute kandi igisagara ba sogokuruza bahambwemwo gisigaye ari umusaka, kandi n’amarembo yaho akaba yaratongowe n’umuriro?”
Umwami arambaza ati: “None wipfuza iki?” Nuko nca nsenga Imana yo mw’ijuru,
maze nishura umwami nti: “Nivyaba biguhimbaye mwami kandi nkaba ngiriwe ubuntu mu nyonga zawe, undungike mu gisagara c’i Buyuda aho ba sogokuruza bahambwe kugira ngo nshobore kugisanura.”
Maze umwami, aho yari yicaranye n’umwamikazi, arambaza ati: “Mbega urugendo rwawe ruzomara imisi ingahe, uzogaruka ryari?” Maze bihimbara umwami kundeka ngo ngende; nanje ndamubwira imisi nzomara.
Ndongera ndamubwira nti: “Nivyaba biguhimbaye, mwami, umpe amakete nzoha abakuru b’intara bo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, kugira ngo bandeke ndengane gushika i Buyuda.

Kandi umpe n’ikete rya Asafu, uwujejwe amashamba y’umwami, kugira ngo aze ampe imbaho zo kumanika maze kwubaka amarembo y’umugwa, i ruhande y’Ingoro, kwubaka uruzitiro rw’igisagara hamwe n’inzu nzobamwo.” Kandi kubera ikiganza ciza c’Imana yanje cari kuri jewe, umwami ampa ivyo ndamusavye.
Nuko ngenda ku bakuru b’intara zo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate ndabaha ayo makete y’umwami. Kandi umwami yari yarungitse abakuru b’ingabo n’abagendera ku mafarasi ngo bamperekeze.
Sanibalati Umuhoroni na Tobiya umukuru w’Umwamoni bumvise ivyo, birabababaza cane kuko haje umuntu aje kugirira neza Abisirayeli.
Nuko nja i Yerusalemu, ndahamara imisi itatu.

Maze ndasohoka mw’ijoro turi kumwe n’abantu bakeya. Sinari nabwiye umuntu n’umwe ico Imana yari yashize ku mutima wanje co gukorera i Yerusalemu. Nta bindi bitungwa vyo kugenderako vyari bihari kiretse indogoba nagenderako.
Muri iryo joro ndasohoka nca mw’Irembo ryo mu Kiyaya nerekeye kw’iriba ry’imbwebwe no kw’Irembo ry’Umwavu, nihweza inzitiro z’i Yerusalemu, ingene zasenyutse, n’amarembo yaho ingene yahiye.
Nuko ndabandanya nerekeye kw’Irembo ry’Iriba riri hafi y’ikidengeri c’umwami, ariko indogoba nagenderako ntiyashobora kuronka aho ica hakwiye ngo irengane.
Maze nca ndugana ikiyaya mw’ijoro, nihweza uruzitiro. Kw’iherezo, nca ndahindukira ninjirira mw’Irembo ryo mu Kiyaya.
Abakuru ntibamenye iyo nagiye canke ico nariko ndakora, kuko ntari bwabwire ikintu na kimwe Abayuda canke abaherezi canke abubahwa canke abakuru canke abandi bantu bari gukora ico gikorwa.
Nuko ndababwira nti: “Murabona aya magorwa turimwo: Yerusalemu ni umusaka, kandi amarembo yaho yarahiye. Nimuze, twubake uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo twikureko igitutsi.”
Nongera ndababwira ingene ikiganza ciza c’Imana yanje cabanye nanje n’ivyo umwami yambwiye. Bishurira rimwe bati: “Reka dutangure kwongera kwubaka.” Nuko batangura gukora ico gikorwa ciza.
Ariko Sanibalati Umuhoroni, Tobiya umukuru w’Umwamoni na Geshemu Umwarabu bavyumvise, baraducokora baradukengera. Barabaza bati: “Ivyo muriko murakora ni ibiki? Muriko muragarariza umwami?”

Ndabishura ndababwira nti: “Imana yo mw’ijuru ni yo izotuma tubishobora. Twebwe abasavyi bayo tugira dutangure gusanura, ariko mwebwe, nta mugabane mufise, canke uburenganzira na bumwe canke iragi i Yerusalemu.”

Eliyashibu umuherezi mukuru na bagenziwe b’abaherezi bava hasi barakora, bubaka Irembo ry’Intama. Barishikiriza Imana bashirako n’inzugi, barubaka bashika ku Munara wa Meya, bahashikanira Imana, no gushika ku Munara wa Hananeli.
Abantu b’i Yeriko bubaka igice co hagati, Zakuri na we mwene Imuri yubaka i ruhande yabo.
Irembo ry’Amafi ryubakwa na bene Hasenaya. Bashiraho imyamba basakarirako baca batera inzugi bashiraho n’ibihindizo vyo kugumya urugi iyo rwugaye.
Meremoti mwene Uriya, mwene Hakozi, asanura igice gikurikira. Akurikirwa na Meshulamu mwene Berekiya, mwene Meshezabeli, arasanura, akurikirwa na Zadoki mwene Bayana na we nyene arasanura.
Igice gikurikira gisanurwa n’abantu b’i Tekowa, ariko abubahwa babo ntibagira ico bakora ngo bumvire umukuru wabo.

Irembo Rishaje, ari ryo rya Yeshana, risanurwa na Yohiyada mwene Paseya hamwe na Meshulamu mwene Besodeya. Bashiraho ibishimaryango, baterako inzugi, bashiraho n’ibihindizo vyo kugumya urugi iyo rwugaye.
Bakurikirwa n’abantu b’i Gibeyoni n’i Misipa, Melatiya w’i Gibeyoni na Yadoni w’i Meronoti, batwarwa n’umukuru atwara intara zo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate.

Uziyeli mwene Harihaya, umwe mu bacuzi b’inzahabu, asanura igice gikurikira; na Hananiya, umwe mu bahinga bahingura ibimota neza, asanura ahakurikira aho. Basanura Yerusalemu gushika ku ruzitiro rwagutse.
Refaya mwene Huri, yaganza igice kimwe c’i Yerusalemu, asanura igice gikurikira.
I ruhande yabo, Yedaya mwene Harumafi asanura ahatumberanye n’inzu yiwe, Hatushi mwene Hashabuneya na we asanura igice gikurikira.
Malikiya mwene Harimu na Hashubi mwene Pahati-Mowabu asanura ikindi gice n’umunara w’amatanure.
Shalumu mwene Haloheshi, uwaganza igice kimwe c’i Yerusalemu, asanura igice gikurikira afashijwe n’abakobwa biwe.

Irembo ryo mu Kiyaya ryasanuwe na Hanuni n’ababa i Zanowa. Bararyubaka bashirako n’inzugi zaho, bashiraho n’ibihindizo vyo kugumya urugi iyo rwugaye. Barongera basanura uruzitiro ahantu hangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko igihumbi gushika kw’Irembo ry’Umwavu.
Irembo ry’Umwavu risanurwa na Malikiya mwene Rekabu, uwaganza intara y’i Beti-Hakeremu. Araryubaka ashirako n’inzugi zaho, ashiraho n’ibihindizo vyo kugumya urugi iyo rwugaye.

Irembo ry’Iriba ryasanuwe na Shaluni mwene Koli-Hoze, uwaganza intara ya Misipa. Araryubaka, ararisakara ashirako n’inzugi, ashiraho n’ibihindizo vyo kugumya urugi iyo rwugaye. Yongera asanura uruzitiro rwo ku kidengeri c’i Silowamu, i ruhande y’umurima w’umwami, gushika ku ngazi zimanuka ziva mu Gisagara ca Dawidi.
Hakurikira Nehemiya mwene Azibuki, uwaganza igice c’intara ya Beti-Zuri, arasanura ageza aharabana no ku mva ya Dawidi, gushika ku kidengeri kibika amazi kiri hafi y’inzu y’abahizi.
Abalewi barongowe na Rehumu mwene Bani barakurikira barasanura. Bakurikirwa na Hashabiya, uwaganza igice c’intara ya Keyila, arasanura ku bw’akarere abamwo.
Hakurikira n’abandi benewabo b’Abalewi bari barongowe na Binuwi mwene Henadadi, uwaganza ikindi gice c’ako karere k’i Keyila, barahasanura.
Hakurikira Ezeri mwene Yesuwa, uwaganza i Misipa, asanura igice gikurikira, uhereye aharabana n’ingazi yo ku bubiko bw’ibigwanisho kugeza aho uruzitiro rukatira.
Hakurikira Baruki mwene Zakayi akorana umwete mu gusanura ikindi gice, kuva aho uruzitiro rukatira gushika ku rwinjiriro rw’inzu ya Eliyashibu umuherezi mukuru.
Hakurikira Meremoti mwene Uriya, mwene Hakozi, asanura ikindi gice, kuva ku rwinjiriro rw’inzu ya Eliyashibu gushika aho ruherera.
Abakurikiye mu gusanura bari abaherezi bo mu karere kahakikuje.
Bakurikirwa na Benyamini na Hashubi, basanura imbere y’inzu yabo; baca bakurikirwa na Azariya mwene Mayaseya, mwene Ananiya, asanura i ruhande y’inzu yiwe.
Akurikirwa na Binuwi mwene Henadadi, asanura ikindi gice, uhereye ku nzu kwa Azariya gushika aho uruzitiro rukatira no mu mfuruka,
maze Palali mwene Uziya akora aharabana n’aho uruzitiro rukatira n’umunara urabana n’ikirimba co haruguru hafi y’urugo rw’umurinzi. Hakurikira Pedaya mwene Paroshi
n’abakozi bo mu Ngoro baba ku musozi wa Ofeli, basanura kugeza aharabana n’Irembo ry’Amazi werekeje mu buseruko n’umunara ku ruhome.
Abantu b’i Tekowa barakurikira, basanura ikindi gice, kuva ku munara w’abararira urusengero gushika ku ruzitiro rwa Ofeli.
Hejuru y’Irembo ry’Amafarasi, abaherezi barahasanura, umwe wese asanura imbere y’inzu yiwe.
Bakurikirwa na Zadoki mwene Imeri, asanura aharabana n’inzu yiwe, Akurikirwa na Shemaya mwene Shekaniya, umurinzi wo kw’Irembo ryo mu Buseruko, arahasanura.
Hananiya mwene Shelemiya, na Hanuni, umuhungu wa gatandatu wa Zalafu barakurikira, basanura ikindi gice. Hakurikira Meshulamu mwene Berekiya asanura imbere y’icumba ciwe.
Malikiya, umwe mu bacuzi b’inzahabu arakurikira, asanura gushika ku nzu y’abakozi bo mu Ngoro n’abadandaza, aharabana n’Irembo ry’Ubugenduzi, no gushika ku cumba kiri hejuru y’aho uruzitiro rukatira.
Hagati y’icumba kiri hejuru y’aho uruzitiro rugarukira n’Irembo ry’Intama ni ho abacuzi b’inzahabu n’abadandaza basanuye.
Sanibalati yumvise ko turiko turubaka uruzitiro, arashavura cane, uburake buramusaza. Aca acokora Abayuda,

maze ari imbere y’abari bamushigikiye hamwe n’ingabo z’i Samariya, avuga ati: “Abo Bayuda b’abanyantegenke bariko barakora ibiki? Bazoshobora gusanura uruzitiro rwabo? Bazotanga ibimazi? Bibaza ko boruheza ku musi umwe? Boshobora kugarukana arya mabuye bayakuye mu misaka yahiye, n’ukuntu yahiye?”
Tobiya Umwamoni yari i ruhande yiwe na we avuga ati: “Ivyo bariko barubakisha amabuye, n’imbwebwe yovyurirako, vyosenyukira hasi vyose!”
Maze nca ndasenga nti: “Dutege amatwi, yewe Mana yacu, kubw’aka gakengerwe. Uhindukize ivyo bitutsi vyabo bibe ari bo bisubira ku mitwe. Ivyabo binyagwe bari mu kinyago.
Ntutwikire ibigabitanyo vyabo canke ngo ukure imbere yawe ivyaha vyabo, kuko batutse abubatsi bari ku gikorwa.”
Nuko turubaka uruzitiro gushika rugeze hagati, kuko abantu bakora n’umutima wabo wose.
Ariko Sanibalati, Tobiya n’Abarabu, Abamoni n’abantu b’i Ashidodi bumvise ko ugusanura uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu kubandanya kandi ko ibihengeri bimaze kuzibirwa, barashavura cane.
Baca baja inama ngo baze kugwanya ab’i Yerusalemu kugira ngo batuburagize.
Ariko dusenga Imana yacu dushiraho n’abarinzi ku murango no mw’ijoro ngo twikingire.
Muri ico gihe, abantu b’i Buyuda bari bavuze bati: “Abubatsi bagenda bacika intege, kandi isakamburira ni ryinshi cane ku buryo tudashobora gusanura uruzitiro.”
Maze abansi bacu baravuga bati: “Tuzogenda tububire batabizi, tubice, igikorwa gihagarare.”
Ariko Abayuda babana na bo baca baza kutuburira, batubwiye incuro icumi zose bati: “Aho mutumbera hose, mumenye ko bazoza kudutera.”
Nuko nca nshira abantu ahantu hose h’urutiziro hameze nk’ahacokeye, baja ahantu habona, ndabatora nisunze imiryango yabo, bitwaje inkota zabo, amacumu n’imiheto.

Mu nyuma ndaraba, ndahaguruka mbwira abakuru, abatware n’abandi bantu nti: “Ntimubatinye. Mwibuke ko Imana ikomeye kandi ihambaye, maze mugwanire benewanyu, abahungu n’abakobwa banyu, abagore banyu n’amazu yanyu.”
Abansi bacu bumvise ko twamenye inama zabo kandi ko Imana yazisambuye, duca dusubira ku ruzitiro, umwe wese ku gikorwa ciwe.
Kuva uwo musi, igice c’abantu banje carubaka, ikindi gice kikaba gifise amacumu, inkinzo, imiheto n’ibigwanisho. Abakuru b’ingabo na bo bagatonda inyuma y’abantu bose b’i Buyuda
bariko barubaka uruzitiro. Abatwara ivyo kwubakisha bakora igikorwa cabo n’ukuboko kumwe ukundi gufise ikigwanisho,
kandi umuntu wese mu bubaka yaba yambaye inkota yiwe mu mbavu agashishikara akora. Ariko uwavuza inzamba yagumana nanje.
Nuko mbwira abanyacubahiro, abakuru n’abandi bantu nti: “Igikorwa ni kinini kandi kiragutse, kandi turasanzaye ku ruzitiro.
Aho muza kwumvira inzamba ivuze muce mudusanga aho nyene. Imana yacu iratugwanirira!”
Nuko tubandanya igikorwa igice kimwe gifise amacumu, kuva mu gitondo hatarabona neza gushika inyenyeri ziserutse.
Muri ico gihe nongera mbwira abantu nti: “Umuntu wese narare i Yerusalemu ari kumwe n’umukozi wiwe, kugira ngo mw’ijoro bararire maze ku murango naho bakore.”
Yaba jewe canke abo tuvukana, abantu banje canke abarinzi bari kumwe nanje, nta n’umwe yigeze akura impuzu; umwe wese yari afise ikigwanisho ciwe, no mu kuja kuvoma amazi.
Maze abagabo n’abagore babo bidodombera benewabo b’Abayuda.
Bamwe bavuga bati: “Twebwe n’abahungu bacu n’abakobwa bacu turi benshi; dukwiye kuronka ingano kugira ngo turye tubone kubaho.”
Abandi bavuga bati: “Turiko turatanga ingwati y’amatongo yacu, imizabibu yacu n’amazu yacu kugira ngo turonke ingano muri iki kigoyi.”
Abandi bavuga bati: “Twasavye ingurane y’amahera kugira ngo dushobore kuriha ikori ry’umwami ku matongo yacu n’imizabibu yacu.

Naho dusangiye amaraso n’Abayuda benewacu n’abana bacu bakamera nk’ababo, dutegerezwa kugurisha abahungu n’abakobwa bacu ngo babe abagurano babo kugira ngo dushobore kuronka ibidutunga. Bamwe mu bakobwa bacu baramaze kuba abagurano, kandi ntitugira uko tubigenza kuko amatongo yacu n’imizabibu yacu na vyo nyene vyamaze kuba ivy’abandi.”
Numvise ugutaka kwabo n’ivyo bidodomba, ndaraka cane.
Ngisha inama umutima wanje, maze ntonganya abakuru n’abacamanza. Ndababwira nti: “Muriko muraguranira kuronka inyungu kuri benewanyu!” Nuko nca nkoranya ikoraniro rinini kugira ngo mvuge ivyabo

maze ndavuga nti: “Twakoze uko dushoboye kwose kugira ngo tugarukane benewacu b’Abayuda bari baraguzwe n’abanyamahanga. Ubu rero ni mwebwe muriko murabagurisha kandi ngo basubire mu buja. None tuzobaguranuza kangahe?” Barahora, kuko batashobora kuronka ico bavuga.
Nuko ndabandanya nti: “Ivyo muriko murakora si vyiza. Mbega ntimwari mukwiye kugendera mu kwubaha Imana yacu kugira ngo ntimube agatwengo ku bansi bacu b’abanyamahanga?
Jewe, abo tuvukana n’abantu banje twaratanze ingurane duha abantu amahera n’ingano. Ariko ntituzokwongera kubasaba inyungu y’ivyo badufitiye.
Nimusubize ubu nyene amatongo, imizabibu, imyelayo n’amazu vyabo, n’inyungu yose mwabatse, ca kigira ijana c’amahera, c’ingano, c’umuvinyu n’ico amavuta.”
Baravuga bati: “Turabisubiza kandi nta kindi tubasaba. Tubikora nk’uko uvuze.” Nuko ntumako abaherezi n’abakuru n’abacamanza ngo barahirire imbere yabo ko bazokora ivyo basezeranye.

Maze nca nkunkumura umusozo w’impuzu yanje mvuga nti: “Uku azobe ari ko Imana ikunkumura umuntu wese atazoshitsa ivyo yasezeranye, imukure mu nzu yiwe no mu vyo atunze vyose. Uko azobe ari ko umuntu nk’uyo akunkumurwa asigare ata na kimwe afise!” Mvuze ivyo ikoraniro ryose riravuga riti: “Amen,” baca bahimbaza Uhoraho . Kandi abantu bashitsa ivyo basezeranye.

Vyongeye, kuva ku mwaka wa mirongo ibiri umwami Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma, maze kugenwa ngo mbe umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda, kugeza ku mwaka wa mirongo itatu n’ibiri, imyaka icumi n’ibiri, yaba jewe canke abo tuvukana ntitwigeze na rimwe turya ivyagerewe umukuru w’intara.

Ariko abakuru b’intara batwitangiye imbere, abatwaye imbere yanje, baremeka umutwaro uremereye abantu bakabasaba shekeli mirongo ine z’ifeza ziyongera ku mfungurwa n’umuvinyu. Ivyegera vyabo na vyo nyene bari bafise ivyo baremereza abantu. Ariko ku bwo kwubaha Imana sinakora nk’uko.
Ahubwo, niyegurira igikorwa co ku ruzitiro. Abantu banje bose bari bakoraniye ngaho ku bwo kwubaka urwo ruzitiro; ntitwigeze tugura itongo na rimwe.
Vyongeye, Abayuda n’abakuru ijana na mirongo itanu bafungura ku meza yanje, hamwe n’abaza iwacu bavuye mu bihugu bidukikije.

Ku musi, bantegurira inka imwe, intama zitandatu z’indobanurwa n’inkoko, kandi uko imisi icumi iheze ni ko bantegurira imivinyu myinshi y’ubwoko bwose. Naho vyari uko, sinigeze nsaba imfungurwa zagerewe umukuru w’intara, kuko abantu bari baremerewe n’ibikorwa.
Unyibukane imbabazi zawe, yewe Mana yanje, kubera ivyo nakoreye ubu bwoko.
Sanibalati, Tobiya, Geshemu Umwarabu n’abandi bansi bacu bumvise ko nasanuye uruzitiro kandi ko ata hantu na hamwe hagisambutse, naho mu vy’ukuri ico gihe ntari bwatereko inzugi ku marembo,
Sanibalati na Geshemu barungika ubutumwa buvuga ngo: “Nuze, duhurire muri kimwe mu bigwati vyo mu kiyaya c’i Ono.” Ariko bariko barategura kungirira nabi;
nuko ndungika intumwa ndabatumako nti: “Ndiko ndakora igikorwa gihambaye sinshobora kukireka ngo manuke hiyo. Ni iki cotuma mpagarika igikorwa ngo nze tubonane?”
Barungika ubwo butumwa incuro zine zose, kandi igihe cose nabishura nk’uko nyene.
Maze ku ncuro ya gatanu, Sanibalati arungika umukozi wiwe aza anzaniye ubwo butumwa, kandi yari afise mu ntoke ikete ritariko ikidodo

ryari ryanditsemwo ngo: “Biravugwa mu mahanga, kandi Geshemu avuga ko ari ukuri, ko wewe n’Abayuda muriko muraja inama yo kugarariza, ni co gituma muriko murubaka uruzitiro. Vyongeye, nk’uko izo nkuru zivuga, ngo ugomba kuba umwami wabo

kandi ngo waramaze no gushiraho abavugishwa kugira ngo bamamaze ivyo bintu i Yerusalemu bavuga bati: ‘Hariho umwami i Buyuda!’ Ubu rero iyi nkuru izohava ishikira umwami; ni na yo mpamvu ukwiye kuza ngo duhure tubivugane.”
Ndamurungikira inyishu nti: “Nta kintu kimeze nk’ico kiriko kirakorwa; iryo ni irementanya ukuye mu mutwe wawe.”
Bariko baragerageza kudutera ubwoba, bibaza bati: “Amaboko yabo azocika intege igikorwa kibananire, maze ntibagiheraheze.” Ariko ndasenga mvuga nti: “Nkomereza amaboko.”

Umusi umwe nja ku nzu ya Shemaya mwene Delaya, Delaya mwene Mehetabeli, yari yiyugaranye iwe. Maze ambwira ati: “Nuze duhurire mu Ngoro y’Imana, imbere mu rusengero, hanyuma twugare inzugi z’urusengero, kuko hariho abantu bagomba kuza kukwica. Bahenga mw’ijoro bace baza kukwica.”
Ariko ndamwishura nti: “Umugabo nkanje yohunga? Canke umuntu nkanje yoja mu Ngoro ngo akize amagara yiwe? Singenda!”
Nca menya neza ko atari Imana yamutumye, ariko ko yavugishirijwe kungwanya kuko Tobiya na Sanibalati bari bamuhereye.
Yari yahawe impera ngo antere ubwoba ngo nkore icaha mu gukora ivyo, na bo bace baronka ivyo bishimikiza mu kunsuzugura.
Wibuke Tobiya na Sanibalati, yewe Mana yanje, ku bw’ivyo bakoze; wibuke na wa muvugishwakazi Nowadiya n’abandi bavugishwa bagerageje kuntera ubwoba.
Nuko uruzitiro rurangira kwubakwa ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na gatanu w’ukwezi kwa Eluli, tumaze imisi mirongo itanu n’ibiri turwubaka.
Abansi bacu bose bavyumvise, amahanga yari adukikije agira ubwoba bacika intege, kuko bamenye ko twakoze ico gikorwa dufashijwe n’Imana yacu.
Kandi, muri iyo misi abanyacubahiro b’i Buyuda barungikira Tobiya amakete menshi, na Tobiya akabishura.
Kuko benshi mu bantu b’i Buyuda bari bafitaniye amasezerano na we kuko yari umukwe wa Shekaniya mwene Ara, umuhungu wiwe na we Yehohanani akaba yari yararongoye umukobwa wa Meshulamu mwene Berekiya.
Mbere baza barandatira ibikorwa vyiwe vyiza, bagaca baja kumubwira ivyo navuze vyose. Maze Tobiya agaca arungika amakete yo kuntera ubwoba.
Uruzitiro rumaze gusanurwa nkamara no gutera inzugi, haciye hashirwaho abarinzi b’amarembo n’abaririmvyi n’Abalewi.
Nshiraho Hanani, uwo tuvukana ngo atware i Yerusalemu, ari kumwe na Hananiya umukuru w’ingabo zo mu gisagara c’i Yerusalemu, kuko yari umuntu w’intungane kandi yubaha Imana kurusha abandi benshi.

Ndababwira nti: “Amarembo y’i Yerusalemu ntaze yugururwe kugeza ku musase. Abarinzi b’amarembo bakiri ku gikorwa cabo, muze mwugare inzugi mushireko n’ibihindizo bigumya inzugi zugaye. Kandi muze mushinge ababa i Yerusalemu ngo babe abarinzi, bamwe ku birindiro vyabo abandi imbere y’amazu yabo.”
Muri ico gihe igisagara cari caragutse ari kinini, ariko hari abantu bake bakibamwo, kandi n’amazu ntiyari bwasanurwe.

Nuko Imana yanje ishira ku mutima wanje kwegeraniriza hamwe abanyacubahiro, abakuru n’abantu bose kugira ngo biyandikishe uko imiryango yabo iri. Maze ntora igitabu canditswemwo abari baragarutse ubwa mbere. Ibi ni vyo nasanze vyanditswemwo:

Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’abantu bo muri iyo ntara baduze bavuye mu kinyago abo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yari yarajanye nk’inyagano i Babiloni. Abo ni bo bagarutse i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda, umwe wese aja mu gisagara c’iwabo.
Bari baherekejwe na Zerubabeli, Yesuwa, Nehemiya, Azariya, Rayamiya, Nahamani, Moridekayi, Bilushani, Misipereti, Bigivayi, Nehumu na Bayana. Urutonde rw’abagabo bo mu Bisirayeli ni uru:
Abakomoka kuri Paroshi ni ibihumbi bibiri n’ijana na mirongo indwi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Shefatiya ni amajana atatu na mirongo indwi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Ara ni amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Pahati-Mowabu, biciye kuri Yesuwa na Yowabu ni ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana umunani na cumi n’umunani.
Abakomoka kuri Elamu ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Zatu ni amajana umunani na mirongo ine na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Zakayi ni amajana indwi na mirongo itandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Binuwi ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ine n’umunani.
Abakomoka kuri Bebayi ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Abakomoka kuri Azigadi ni ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Adonikamu ni amajana atandatu na mirongo itandatu n’indwi.
Abakomoka kuri Bigivayi ni ibihumbi bibiri na mirongo itandatu n’indwi.
Abakomoka kuri Adini ni amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Ateri, biciye kuri Hezekiya ni mirongo icenda n’umunani.
Abakomoka kuri Hashumi ni amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Abakomoka kuri Bezayi ni amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Harifu ni ijana na cumi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Gibeyoni ni mirongo icenda na batanu.
Abantu b’i Betelehemu n’i Netofa ni ijana na mirongo umunani n’umunani.
Ab’i Anatoti ni ijana na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Ab’i Beti-Azimaveti ni mirongo ine na babiri.
Ab’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, Kefira na Beroti ni amajana indwi na mirongo ine na batatu.
Ab’i Rama n’i Geba ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri n’umwe.
Ab’i Mikimashi ni ijana na mirongo ibiri na babiri.
Ab’i Beteli n’i Hayi ni ijana na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Ab’i Nebo handi ni mirongo itanu na babiri.
Ab’i Elamu handi ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Harimu ni amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri.
Ab’i Yeriko ni amajana atatu na mirongo ine na batanu.
Ab’i Lodi, Hadidi n’i Ono ni amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri n’umwe.
Abakomoka kuri Senaya ni ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana icenda na mirongo itatu.
Abaherezi: Abakomoka kuri Yedaya, biciye mu muryango wa Yesuwa, ni amajana icenda na mirongo indwi na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Imeri ni igihumbi na mirongo itanu na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Pashuri ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo ine n’indwi.
Abakomoka kuri Harimu ni igihumbi na cumi n’indwi.
Abalewi: Abakomoka kuri Yesuwa, biciye kuri Kadimiyeli mu ruvyaro rwa Hodaviya, ni mirongo indwi na bane.

Abarinzi b’irembo ry’urusengero: Abakomoka kuri Shalumu, Ateri, Talumoni, Akubu, Hatita na Shobayi ni ijana na mirongo itatu n’umunani.
Abakozi bo mu Ngoro: Abakomoka kuri Ziha, Hasufa, Tabawoti,
Kerosi, Siya, Padoni,

Abakomoka ku bakozi ba Salomo: Abakomoka kuri Sotayi, Sofereti, Perida,
Yayala, Darukoni, Gideli,

Abakozi bo mu Ngoro n’abakomoka ku bakozi ba Salomo bose hamwe ni amajana atatu na mirongo icenda na babiri.
Aba bakurikira baduze bavuye mu bisagara vya Teli-Melahi, Teli-Harusha, Kerubi, Adoni na Imeri, ariko ntibashoboye kwerekana ko imiryango yabo ikomoka ku Bisirayeli:
Abakomoka kuri Delaya, Tobiya na Nekoda ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ine na babiri.
Mu baherezi: Abakomoka kuri Habaya, Hakozi na Baruzilayi, umugabo yari yarongoye umukobwa wa Baruzilayi Umunyagileyadi agaca yitirirwa iryo zina nyene.
Abo ni bo barondeye intonde za ba sekuruza b’imiryango yabo, ariko ntibashobora kuzironka, maze baca bakurwa mu gikorwa c’ubuherezi nk’abahumanye.
Umukuru w’intara, aca abategeka kutarya ivyejejwe gushika haje umuherezi agasiguza Uhoraho akoresheje Urimu na Tumimu.
Igitigiri c’abantu bose cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bibiri n’amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu,
ukuyemwo ibihumbi indwi n’amajana atatu na mirongo itatu n’indwi vy’abagurano n’abaguranokazi; kandi bari bafise abagabo n’abagore b’abaririmvyi amajana abiri na mirongo ine na batanu.
Bari bafise amafarasi amajana indwi na mirongo itatu n’atandatu, indogoba amajana abiri na mirongo ine na zitanu,
ingamiya amajana ane na mirongo itatu na zitanu n’indogoba ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri.

Bamwe mu bakuru b’imiryango barafashije muri ico gikorwa. Umukuru w’intara atanga mu bubiko ingero dariki igihumbi z’inzahabu, ibikombe mirongo itanu n’impuzu amajana atanu na mirongo itatu z’abaherezi.
Bamwe bo mu bakuru b’imiryango batanga mu bubiko bw’ico gikorwa ingero dariki ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’inzahabu n’ingero mina ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana abiri z’ifeza.
Ivyatanzwe n’abantu basigaye vyose hamwe zari ingero dariki ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’inzahabu, ingero mina ibihumbi bibiri z’ifeza n’impuzu mirongo itandatu n’indwi z’abaherezi.
Abaherezi, Abalewi, abarinzi b’irembo, abaririmvyi n’abakozi bo mu Ngoro, bari kumwe n’abandi bantu hamwe n’Abisirayeli bose baja kuba mu bisagara vyabo.

Maze abantu bose bakoranira hamwe nk’umuntu umwe mu kibuga kiri imbere y’Irembo ry’Amazi. Babwira Ezira umwigisha w’Ivyanditswe ngo asohore Igitabu c’Ivyagezwe vya Mose, ivyo Uhoraho yari yarahaye Abisirayeli.
Maze ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi Ezira umuherezi azana Ivyagezwe imbere y’ikoraniro, ryari rigizwe n’abagabo n’abagore bashobora gutahura.

Abisoma n’ijwi rirenga uhereye mu gitondo gushika ku murango atumbereye ku kibuga c’imbere y’Irembo ry’Amazi imbere y’abagabo, abagore n’abandi bashobora gutahura kandi abantu bose bumviriza batekereje ivyo mu gitabu c’Ivyagezwe.

Ezira umunyabwenge w’Ivyanditswe ahagarara ahatamuratse hubatswe mu biti ku bwo ico gikorwa. I ruhande yiwe i buryo hari hahagaze Matitiya, Shema, Anaya, Uriya, Hilikiya na Mayaseya; i bubampfu bwiwe hari Pedaya, Mishayeli, Malikiya, Hashumi, Hashibadana, Zakariya na Meshulamu.
Ezira azingurura ca gitabu. Abantu bose bashobora kumubona kuko yari ahagaza ahataramutse; amaze kukizingurura, abantu bose barahaguruka.
Ezira ahimbaza Uhoraho Imana ihambaye; maze abantu bose baduza amaboko barishura bati: “Amen! Amen!” Baca barunama basenga Uhoraho bubamye hasi.
Abalewi ari bo Yesuwa, Bani, Sherebiya, Yamini, Akubu, Shabetayi, Hodiya, Mayaseya, Kelita, Azariya, Yozabadi, Hanani na Pelaya, bigisha abantu ivyo mu Vyagezwe abantu bagihagaze ngaho.
Basoma mu Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana, barabitomora, babiha n’insiguro kugira ngo abantu bashobore gutahura ivyariko birasomwa.

Nuko Nehemiya umukuru w’intara, Ezira umuherezi n’umwigisha w’ivyagezwe, n’Abalewi bariko barigisha abantu bababwira bose bati: “Uyu musi ni Uwera k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Ntimugandare canke ngo murire.” Kuko abantu bose bariko bararira uko bumviriza amajambo yo mu Vyagezwe.

Nehemiya aravuga ati: “Nimugende murye ibiryoshe munywe n’ibinyobwa bisosa, kandi murungikire n’abatateguye na kimwe. Uwu musi ni uwera k’ Uhoraho Imana yacu. Ntimubabare, kuko umunezero w’ Uhoraho ari wo nkomezi zanyu.”
Abalewi bamama abantu bose, bavuga bati: “Nimutekereze, kuko uwu ari umusi wera. Ntimubabare.”
Nuko abantu bose baca bagenda kurya no kunywa, no kurungikiranira ivyokurya no guhimbaza banezerewe cane, kuko bari batahuye amajambo bari bamenyeshejwe.
Ku musi wa kabiri w’uko kwezi, abakuru b’imiryango, bari kumwe n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, bakoranira aho umwigisha w’Ivyagezwe Ezira ari, kugira ngo bumvirize neza amajambo yo mu Vyagezwe.
Basanga mu Vyagezwe, ivyo Uhoraho yari yaratanze acishije kuri Mose, handitse ngo Abisirayeli baze babe mu nsago bagire umusi mukuru wo mu kwezi kw’indwi

kandi ko bari bakwiye kwamamaza iryo jambo bakarikwiragiza mu bisagara vyabo n’i Yerusalemu ngo: “Nimusohoke muduge mu ntara y’imisozi maze muzane amashami mwakuye ku biti vy’imyelayo yo mu mirima hamwe n’ibiti vy’imyelayo yo mw’ishamba, no ku miriteli, ku bigazi no ku biti vyose bizitanye, kugira ngo mwubake insago nk’uko vyanditswe.”

Nuko abantu barasohoka bazana amashami biyubakira utuzu dutoduto imbere y’inzu zabo, mu ngo zabo, imbere y’Ingoro y’Imana no ku kibuga kiri i ruhande y’Irembo ry’Amazi n’ikiri i ruhande y’Irembo rya Efurayimu.
Abantu bose bari baravuye mu kinyago bubaka insago bazibamwo. Kuva mu gihe ca Yesuwa mwene Nuni gushika uwo musi, Abisirayeli ntibari bwahimbaze uwo musi mukuru nk’uko. Maze baranezerwa cane.

Uko umusi utashe, uhereye ku musi wa mbere gushika ku wa nyuma, Ezira yama abasomera ico Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana; bagahimbaza uwo musi mukuru imisi indwi, maze ku musi w’umunani hakaba ikoraniro rinini nk’uko vyari bitegekanijwe.

headings.text: Ezira asoma ivyagezwe Kandi ukwezi kw’indwi kwashitse Abisirayeli bamaze kuja mu bisagara vyabo.

verses.text: Ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwo kwezi nyene, Abisirayeli bakoranira hamwe, bisonzesheje, bambaye amagunira bisuriyeko umukungugu ku mitwe.
Abakomoka kuri Isirayeli bose bari bitandukanije n’abanyamahanga bose. Bahagarara mu bibanza vyabo batura ivyaha vyabo n’ibibi vyose ba sekuruza bari barakoze.
Bahagarara aho bari bari maze basoma mu Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yabo amasaha atandatu, bongera bamara ayandi masaha atandatu batura ivyaha vyabo basenga Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Abalewi bari bahagaze ku ngazi: Yesuwa, Bani, Kadimiyeli, Shebaniya, Buni, Sherebiya, Bani na Kenani, bambaza Uhoraho Imana yabo n’ijwi rirenga.

Kandi Abalewi ari bo Yesuwa, Kadimiyeli, Bani, Hashabuneya, Sherebiya, Hodiya, Shebaniya na Petahiya, baravuga bati: “Nimuhaguruke muhimbaze Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yamyeho kandi izokwamaho.” Barasenga bati: “Izina ryawe ry’icubahiro riragahezagirwa, kandi rishirwe hejuru y’imihezagiro yose no guhimbazwa kwose.

Ni wewe wenyene Uhoraho . Waremye amajuru, mbere n’amajuru asumba ayandi, n’inyenyeri zose, isi n’ibiyuzuye, ibiyaga n’ibiri muri vyo. Ni wewe utanga ubuzima ku bintu vyose, kandi ingabo zo mw’ijuru ziragusenga.
Ni wewe wenyene Uhoraho Imana, watoranije Aburamu umukura muri Uri mu Bukaludaya maze umwita Aburahamu.

Wabonye ko umutima wiwe ukuyoboka, uca ugirana isezerano na we ngo uze uhe uruvyaro rwiwe igihugu c’Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abamori, Abaperizi, Abayebusi n’Abagirugashi. Wakomeje isezerano ryawe kuko ugororoka.
Wabonye imibabaro ba sogokuruza barimwo muri Egiputa; wumvise ugutaka kwabo bari ku Kiyaga Gitukura.
Weretse ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza Farawo, ku bakuru no ku bantu bose bo mu gihugu ciwe, kuko wari uzi ingene Abanyegiputa babatwaza amanyama. Wabaye rurangiranwa, kandi n’ubu uracari rurangiranwa.
Waciyemwo kubiri Ikiyaga Gitukura imbere yabo, kugira ngo barengane muri co baca ahumutse, ariko ababakurikira amazi yarabarengeye, nk’uko ibuye ryibira mu mupfunda w’amazi.
Ku murango wabarongoza inkingi y’igicu, maze mw’ijoro ukabarongoza inkingi y’umuriro ngo ubamurikire mu nzira bacamwo.
Waje uvuye ku musozi Sinayi; wavuganye na bo uri mw’ijuru. Wabahaye ibibagenga n’ivyagezwe bitunganye, amabwirizwa n’amategeko meza.
Wabamenyesheje ivy’Isabato yawe yera maze ubaha amategeko, amabwirizwa, n’ivyagezwe ubicishije ku musavyi wawe Mose.

Igihe bari bashonje wabahaye ivyokurya bivuye mw’ijuru n’igihe bari banyotewe wabahaye amazi avuye mu gitandara. Wabategetse kwinjira no kwegukira igihugu wari wararahiye umanitse ukuboko ko uzokibaha.
Ariko ba sogokuruza bagira amanyama baragarariza, maze ntibitondera ivyo wategetse.

Banka kwumva bibananira no kwibuka ibitangaza wakoreye muri bo. Baragarariza, maze bishingira uwo kubarongora ngo basubire mu buja bwabo. Ariko uri Imana iharira, uri inyabuntu igira imbabazi, iteba kuraka kandi y’urukundo rwinshi. Ni co catumye utabaheba,
no mu gihe bibumbira igishushanyo c’ishuri bakavuga bati: ‘Iyi ni yo mana yanyu, yabakuye muri Egiputa,’ canke igihe bakurogotako bakagutuka.
Kubera imbabazi zawe nyinshi ntiwabahebeye mu bugaragwa. Ku murango inkingi y’igicu ntiyaretse kubarongora mu nzira yabo, canke inkingi y’umuriro mw’ijoro ngo ireke kubamurikira mu nzira yabo bajana.
Wabahaye Mpwemu wawe mwiza ngo abahe gutahura. Ntiwabimye manu ngo babure ico barya, kandi wabahaye n’amazi abamara inyota.
Mu myaka mirongo ine yose warabashigikiye mu bugaragwa; nta co bigeze bakena, impuzu zabo ntizigeze zishira canke ngo ibirenge vyabo bivyimbe.
Wagabuye mu maboko yabo ubwami n’amahanga, kugira ngo ubahe n’intara zari zikikije ico gihugu cabo. Bigaruriye igihugu ca Sihoni umwami w’i Heshiboni n’igihugu ca Ogi umwami w’i Bashani.
Wagwije abahungu babo bangana n’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, maze ubazana mu gihugu wari warabwiye ba sekuruza ko bazocinjira kikaba icabo bwite.

Abahungu babo baracinjiye kiba icabo bwite. Wirukanye Abanyakanani imbere yabo, baba muri ico gihugu; wagabuye Abanyakanani mu maboko yabo, hamwe n’abami babo n’abantu baba muri ico gihugu, ngo babakoreshe ico bashaka.

Bigaruriye ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro n’amatongo yimbuka; bigaruriye amazu yuzuye ivyiza vyinshi vy’uburyo bwinshi, amariba yimbwe, imizabibu, imyelayo n’ibiti vy’ivyamwa vyinshi cane. Bararya barahaga maze baravyibuha; banezererwa ivyiza wabahaye.
Ariko ntibumvira barakugarariza; batera ibitugu Ivyagezwe vyawe, bica abavugishwa nawe, bari babatumweko ngo baguhindukirire bakugarukeko; bakora ivyo kukurogotako bisesema.

Ni co catumye ubagabura mu maboko y’abansi babo, barabacinyiza. Ariko bamaze gucinyizwa baragutakira. Ubumva uri mw’ijuru, maze ku bw’imbabazi zawe nyinshi ubarungikira abo kubakiza, babarokora mu maboko y’abansi babo.

Ariko bamaze kudibama, basubira gukora ibibi mu nyonga zawe. Uca ubarekurira mu maboko y’abansi babo ngo babaganze. Maze bagutakambiye kandi, ubumva uri mw’ijuru, kubera imbabazi zawe urongera urabatabara kandi ubikora wikurikiranya kenshi.

Urabinginga ngo bahindukirire ivyagezwe vyawe, ariko bagira amanyama ntibumvira amabwirizwa yawe. Bacumura ku mategeko yawe kandi ari yo azobeshaho umuntu ayumvira. Bakomantaza imitima, maze barahindukira baguha umugongo, baragarariza banka kwumva.
Wabihanganiye imyaka myinshi. Wababuriye ubicishije muri Mpwemu wawe yari mu bavugishwa nawe. Ariko ntibavyitayeho, ni co catumye ubarekurira mu maboko y’amahanga yari abakikije.
Ariko kubera imbabazi zawe nyinshi ntiwabaherengeteje canke ngo ubahebe, kuko uri Imana y’inyabuntu kandi y’inyembabazi.

None rero, Mana yacu, Mana nkuru, y’inyenkomezi kandi ihambaye, izigama isezerano ry’urukundo, ntiwirengagize ibi bihe bigoye vyadushitseko, n’abami bacu n’abarongozi bacu, ku baherezi bacu no ku bavugishwa n’Imana bacu, kuri ba sogokuruza no ku bantu bose, kuva mu gihe c’abami b’i Ashuri gushika uwu musi.
Mu vyatubayeko vyose, wamye uri uwugororotse; wakoze mu bwizigirwa, ariko tweho twakoze ibibi.
Abami bacu, abaturongora, abaherezi bacu na ba sogokuruza ntibitondeye Ivyagezwe vyawe; ntibashize umutima ku mabwirizwa yawe canke ku mburi wabarungikiye.
No mu gihe bari bakiri mu bwami bwabo, bakinezererwa ukugira neza kwawe kwari kuri bo bakiri mu gihugu kinini kandi cimbuka wabahaye, ntibagukorera canke ngo bahindukire bave mu nzira zabo mbi.
Ariko raba, uwu musi turi abagurano, abagurano mu gihugu wahaye ba sogokuruza kugira ngo barye ivyamwa n’ibindi vyiza cimbuka.
Kubera ivyaha vyacu, ivyimburwa vyaco vyinshi bija ku bami waduhaye ngo batuganze. Ni bo batuganza twe n’amasho yacu uko bishakiye. Natwe turi mu gahinda kenshi.
Ku bw’ivyo, turasezeranye isezerano kandi tuzoryandika, kandi abarongozi bacu, Abalewi bacu n’abaherezi bacu bashireko amazina yabo n’ibidodo vyabo.”

Seraya, Azariya, Yeremiya,
Pashuri, Amariya, Malikiya,
Hatushi, Shebaniya, Maluki,
Harimu, Meremoti, Obadiya,
Daniyeli, Ginetoni, Baruki,
Meshulamu, Abiya, Miyamini,
Mayaziya, Bilugayi na Shemaya. Abo bari abaherezi.
Abalewi: Yesuwa mwene Azaniya, Binuwi wo mu bahungu ba Henadadi, Kadimiyeli,
n’abo bari bafatanije: Shebaniya, Hodiya, Kelita, Pelaya, Hanani,
Mika, Rehobu, Hashabiya,
Zakuri, Sherebiya, Shebaniya,
Hodiya, Bani na Beninu.
Abarongora abantu: Paroshi, Pahati-Mowabu, Elamu, Zatu, Bani,
Buni, Azigadi, Bebayi,
Adoniya, Bigivayi, Adini,
Ateri, Hezekiya, Azuri,
Hodiya, Hashumi, Bezayi,
Harifu, Anatoti, Nebayi,
Magipiyashi, Meshulamu, Heziri,
Meshezabeli, Zadoki, Yaduwa,
Pelatiya, Hanani, Anaya,
Hoseya, Hananiya, Hashubi,
Haloheshi, Piliha, Shobeki,
Rehumu, Hashabuna, Mayaseya,
Ahiya, Hanani, Anani,
Maluki, Harimu na Bayana.

Abasigaye bo mu bantu, abaherezi, Abalewi, abarinzi b’amarembo, abaririmvyi, abakozi bo mu Ngoro hamwe n’abantu bose bitandukanije n’ababanyi babo b’abanyamahanga ku bwo kwumvira Ivyagezwe vy’Imana, hamwe rero n’abagore babo n’abahungu n’abakobwa babo bose bashobora gutahura,

abo bose bifatanya na benewabo b’abanyacubahiro, maze bararahira ko bazokurikiza Ivyagezwe vy’Imana vyatanzwe biciye kuri Mose umusavyi w’Imana no kwitondera amabwirizwa, amategeko n’ivyashinzwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Dusezeranye kudashingira abakobwa bacu ku banyamahanga tubana canke ngo abahungu bacu batware abakobwa babo.

Igihe abanyamahanga tubana bazoba bazanye ibidandazwa canke ingano kugurisha kw’Isabato canke ku wundi musi mukuru wose, ntituzobagurira. Mu mwaka ugira indwi wose ntituzoja kurima kandi tuzohebera abantu amadeni yose badufitiye.
“Twiyemeje ko tuzoshishikara gushira mu ngiro icagezwe co gutanga uko umwaka uheze ica gatatu ca shekeli co gushigikira igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu:

kugira ngo ya mikate yo gushira ku meza, vya bimazi vy’ifu n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro vyama bitangwa ku musi, vya bimazi vyo ku masabato, ya misi mikuru y’imboneko z’ukwezi n’imisi mikuru yategekanijwe, vya bimazi vyera, n’ivy’ivyaha vyo guhongera Abisirayeli, hamwe n’ibikorwa vyose vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu bishobore gukorwa neza.

Twebwe abaherezi, Abalewi n’abantu basanzwe twagize ubupfindo kugira ngo tumenye igihe umuryango wose uzozana mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu mu bihe vyashinzwe vyo ku mwaka, inkwi zitegekanijwe zo gucana ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe.
Twiyemeje kandi kuzana mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho uko umwaka uheze ivyeze imbere y’ibindi mu vyimburwa n’ivyo ku biti vy’ivyamwa.
Kandi nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe, tuzozana imfura zacu z’abahungu n’izavutse ubwa mbere mu nka zacu, no mu mikuku yacu mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu, tubishikirize abaherezi bakorayo.

Vyongeye, tuzozana mu bubiko bw’Ingoro y’Imana yacu, dushikirize abaherezi, ivyeze imbere y’ibindi mu mirima, ivyo mu mashikanwa y’ifu, y’ivyamwa vy’ibiti vyacu n’umutobe w’umuvinyu wacu n’amavuta. Kandi tuzozana ikigiracumi c’ivyo twimbuye tugihe Abalewi, kuko Abalewi ari bo begeranya ibigiracumi mu bisagara vyose aho dukorera.
Umuherezi akomoka kuri Aroni ni we azoherekeza Abalewi mu gihe bazokwakira ibigiracumi, maze Abalewi bazozana ica cumi c’ibigiracumi bakiriye mu vyumba vy’ububiko bw’ubutunzi bw’Ingoro y’Imana yacu.

Abisirayeli, harimwo n’Abalewi, bazozana amashikanwa yabo y’ingano, umutobe mushasha w’umuvinyu n’amavuta, mu vyumba bibikwamwo ibikoresho vy’ahera hafi y’aho abaherezi, abarinzi b’irembo n’abaririmvyi bakorera. Ntituzofata minenerwe Ingoro y’Imana yacu.”

Maze abarongoye abantu baja kuba i Yerusalemu. Ku bandi bantu habanza kugirwa ubupfindo, ngo bamenye umuryango umwe ku miryango icumi uja kuba i Yerusalemu, igisagara cera. Iyo miryango icenda isigaye bategerezwa kuguma mu bisagara vyabo.
Abantu bahezagira cane abemeye ku gushaka kwabo kuja kuba i Yerusalemu.

Aba ni bo batware bari barongoye intara bimukiye i Yerusalemu. Muri ico gihe Abisirayeli benshi, abaherezi, Abalewi, abakozi bo mu Ngoro n’abakomoka ku bakozi ba Salomo baba mu bisagara bitandukanye vy’i Buyuda, umwe wese mw’itongo ryiwe,

ariko abantu bamwe bo mu Bayuda no mu Babenyamini bashima kuba i Yerusalemu: Abakomoka kuri Yuda ni: Ataya mwene Uziya, Uziya mwene Zakariya, Zakariya mwene Amariya, Amariya mwene Shefatiya, Shefatiya mwene Mahalaleli, Mahalaleli wo mu ruvyaro rwa Perezi,
hamwe na Mayaseya mwene Baruki, Baruki mwene Koli-Hoze, Koli-Hoze mwene Hazaya, Hazaya mwene Adaya, Adaya mwene Yoyaribu, Yoyaribu mwene Zakariya, Zakariya akomoka kuri Shela.
Abakomoka kuri Perezi baba i Yerusalemu bashika amajana ane na mirongo itandatu n’umunani, abagabo b’intwari babushitse.
Mu bakomoka kuri Benyamini ni: Salu mwene Meshulamu, Meshulamu mwene Yowedi, Yowedi mwene Pedaya, Pedaya mwene Kolaya, Kolaya mwene Mayaseya, Mayaseya mwene Itiyeli, Itiyeli mwene Yeshaya,
n’abamukurikira, Gabayi na Salayi. Bose hamwe ni abagabo amajana icenda na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Yoweli mwene Zikuri yari umukuru w’ingabo mukuru wabo, na Yuda mwene Hasenuwa yatwara akarere ka kabiri k’igisagara.
Mu bakomoka ku baherezi ni: Yedaya mwene Yoyaribu, Yakini,
Seraya mwene Hilukiya, Hilukiya mwene Meshulamu, Meshulamu mwene Sadoki, Sadoki mwene Merayoti, Merayoti mwene Ahitubu, Ahitubu uwari ajejwe ivyo mu Ngoro y’Imana,

n’abo bari bafatanije, bashishikara igikorwa co mu Ngoro, bari abagabo amajana umunani na mirongo ibiri na babiri. Adaya mwene Yerohamu, Yerohamu mwene Pelaliya, Pelaliya mwene Amuzi, Amuzi mwene Zakariya, Zakariya mwene Pashuri, Pashuri mwene Malikiya,

n’abo bari bafatanije, bari abakuru b’imiryango, bari abagabo amajana abiri na mirongo ine na babiri. Amashisayi mwene Azareli, Azareli mwene Ahizayi, Ahizayi mwene Meshilemoti, Meshilemoti mwene Imeri,
n’abo bari bafatanije, bari abagabo b’intwari, ijana na mirongo ibiri n’umunani. Umukuru w’ingabo yari Zabudiyeli mwene Hagedolimu.
Abakomoka ku Balewi ni: Shemaya mwene Hashubi, Hashubi mwene Azirikamu, Azirikamu mwene Hashabiya, Hashabiya mwene Buni,
Shabetayi na Yozabadi, babiri bo mu bakuru b’Abalewi, bari bajejwe ibikorwa vyo hanze y’Ingoro y’Imana;

Mataniya mwene Mika, Mika mwene Zabudi, Zabudi mwene Asafu, Asafu umurongozi yarongora ibikorwa vyo gushimira Imana no gusenga; Bakibukiya, uwa kabiri mu bari bafatanije na we, na Abuda mwene Shamuwa, Shamuwa mwene Galali, Galali mwene Yedutuni.
Abalewi bo mu gisagara cera bashika amajana abiri na mirongo umunani na bane.
Abarinzi b’irembo ni: Akubu, Talumoni n’abo bari bafatanije, baguma barinze amarembo, bari abagabo ijana na mirongo indwi na babiri.
Abandi Bisirayeli basigaye, hamwe n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, baba mu bisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda, umwe wese mw’itongo rya ba sekuruza.
Abakozi bo mu Ngoro baba ku musozi wa Ofeli, kandi Ziha na Gishupa ni bo bari babarongoye.

Umukuru w’Abalewi i Yerusalemu yari Uzi mwene Bani, Bani mwene Hashabiya, Hashabiya mwene Mataniya, Mataniya mwene Mika. Uzi yari umwe mu bakomotse kuri Asafu, bari abaririmvyi bajejwe igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana.
Abaririmvyi bategekwa n’umwami, ni we yagena ivyo bakora ku musi ku musi.
Petahiya mwene Meshezabeli, umwe mu bakomotse kuri Zera mwene Yuda, yari umukozi w’umwami mu bikorwa vyose vyerekeye kurongora abantu.
Ku bijanye n’ibigwati n’imirima yavyo, bamwe mu bantu b’i Buyuda baba i Kiriyati-Araba no mu bigwati bihakikije, i Diboni no mu bigwati vyaho, i Yekabuzeyeli no mu bigwati vyaho,
i Yesuwa, i Molada, i Beti-Peleti,
i Hazari-Shuwali, i Berisheba no mu bigwati vyaho,
i Zikulagi, i Mekona no mu bigwati vyaho,
i Eni-Rimoni, i Zora, i Yarimuti,
i Zanowa, muri Adulamu no mu bigwati vyaho, i Lakishi no mu mirima yaho, n’i Azeka no mu bigwati vyaho. Nuko baba ngaho uhereye i Berisheba gushika mu kiyaya ca Hinomu.
Abakomoka ku Babenyamini kuva i Geba baba i Mikimashi, Ayiya, Beteli n’ibigwati vyaho,
i Anatoti, Nobu n’i Ananiya,
i Hazori, i Rama n’i Gitayimu,
i Hadidi, i Zeboyimu n’i Nebalati,
i Lodi n’i Ono, no mu kiyaya c’abanyamyuga.
Imwe mu mice y’Abalewi b’i Buyuda baba i Bubenyamini.
Aba ni bo bari abaherezi n’Abalewi bagarutse bari kumwe na Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli ari kumwe na Yesuwa: Seraya, Yeremiya, Ezira,
Amariya, Maluki, Hatushi,
Shekaniya, Rehumu, Meremoti,
Ido, Ginetoni, Abiya,
Miyamini, Mowadiya, Biluga,
Shemaya, Yoyaribu, Yedaya,
Salu, Amoki, Hilikiya na Yedaya. Abo ni bo bari abarongozi b’abaherezi n’abo bari bafatanije mu misi ya Yesuwa.
Abalewi bari Yesuwa, Binuwi, Kadimiyeli, Sherebiya, Yuda na Mataniya, uwari ajejwe indirimbo z’ishimwe, hamwe n’abo bari bafatanije.
Bakibukiya na Uni, abo bari bafatanije, bahagarara barabana na bo mu gihe c’ibikorwa.
Yesuwa yari se wa Yoyakimu, Yoyakimu se wa Eliyashibu, Eliyashibu se wa Yoyada,
Yoyada se wa Yonatani, Yonatani na we akaba se wa Yaduwa.
Mu misi ya Yoyakimu, aba ni bo bari abakuru b’imiryango y’abaherezi: Mu muryango wa Seraya ni Meraya. Mu muryango wa Yeremiya ni Hananiya.
Mu muryango wa Ezira ni Meshulamu. Mu muryango wa Amariya ni Yehohanani.
Mu muryango wa Maluki ni Yonatani. Mu muryango wa Shebaniya ni Yosefu.
Mu muryango wa Harimu ni Adina. Mu muryango wa Meremoti ni Helukayi.
Mu muryango wa Ido ni Zakariya. Mu muryango wa Ginetoni ni Meshulamu.
Mu muryango wa Abiya ni Zikuri. Mu muryango wa Miniyamini no mu muryango wa Mowadiya ni Pilutayi.
Mu muryango wa Biluga ni Shamuwa. Mu muryango wa Shemaya ni Yehonatani.
Mu muryango wa Yoyaribu ni Matenayi. Mu muryango wa Yedaya ni Uzi.
Mu muryango wa Salu ni Kalayi. Mu muryango wa Amoki ni Eberi.
Mu muryango wa Hilikiya ni Hashabiya. Mu muryango wa Yedaya ni Netaneli.
Abakuru b’imiryango y’Abalewi mu misi ya Eliyashibu, Yoyada, Yohanani na Yaduwa, hamwe n’abo mu baherezi, bari banditswe mu bitabu ku ngoma ya Dariyusi Umuperesi.
Abakuru b’imiryango mu bakomoka kuri Lewi kugeza mu gihe ca Yohanani mwene Eliyashibu bari banditswe mu gitabu c’ibigenda biraba.

Kandi abarongozi bo mu Balewi bari Hashabiya, Sherebiya, Yesuwa mwene Kadimiyeli, n’abo bari bafatanije, bahagarara barabana na bo ngo bahimbaze batange n’ishimwe, umugwi ukagomborwa n’uwundi, nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi umuntu w’Imana.
Mataniya, Bakibukiya, Obadiya, Meshulamu; Talumoni na Akubu bari abarinzi b’amarembo bazigama ivyumba vy’ububiko ku marembo.
Bakora mu misi ya Yoyakimu mwene Yesuwa, Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki, no musi ya Nehemiya umukuru w’intara no mu gihe ca Ezira umuherezi n’umwigisha w’Ivyanditswe.

Mu gihe co gushikiriza Imana uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu, baja kurondera Abalewi aho baba barabazana i Yerusalemu ngo bahimbaze mu munezero ukwo gushikiriza Imana uruzitiro bakoresheje indirimbo z’ishimwe bongera bavuza ivyuma bisama, inanga n’amakembe.
Abaririmvyi na bo nyene babegeraniriza hamwe bavuye mu turere dukikuje Yerusalemu, bava mu bigwati vy’Abanetofati,
bava i Beti-Gilugali, no mu karere k’i Geba n’i Azimaveti, kuko abaririmvyi bari barubatse ibigwati vyabo ahakikuje Yerusalemu.
Abaherezi n’Abalewi babanje kwihumanura, hanyuma bahumanura abantu, amarembo n’uruzitiro.

Maze ndugana abarongozi b’i Buyuda baja ku ruzitiro hejuru. Nongera kandi nkoranya imigwi ibiri y’abaririmvyi bo gushimira Imana. Umugwi wa mbere ugendagenda ku ruzitiro hejuru utumbereye i buryo, ushika kw’Irembo ry’Umwavu.
Hoshaya n’igice c’abarongozi b’i Buyuda barabakurikira,
bari kumwe na Azariya, Ezira, Meshulamu,
Yuda, Benyamini, Shemaya, Yeremiya,
hamwe n’abaherezi bamwe bafise inzamba, kandi na Zakariya mwene Yonatani, Yonatani mwene Shemaya, Shemaya mwene Mataniya, Mataniya mwene Mikaya, Mikaya mwene Zakuri, Zakuri mwene Asafu,

n’abo nyene bari bafatanije, Shemaya, Azareli, Milalayi, Gilalayi, Mayayi, Netaneli, Yuda na Hanani, bafise ibicurarangisho vyategetswe na Dawidi umuntu w’Imana. Ezira umwigisha w’Ivyanditswe ni we yari abarongoye.

Maze bageze kw’Irembo ry’Iriba, babandanya baduga ingazi zija mu Gisagara ca Dawidi ku kadugo kaja ku ruzitiro, hanyuma baca hejuru y’ingoro ya Dawidi berekeye kw’Irembo ry’Amazi, ahaherereye mu buseruko.

Umugwi wa kabiri ugendagenda ku ruzitiro, ugenda werekeye i bubamfu kandi utazira Imana. Ndabakurikira ku ruzitiro, turi kumwe n’igice c’abantu, duca hejuru y’umunara w’amatanure twerekeye ku ruzitiro rwagutse,
hanyuma turengana Irembo rya Efurayimu, Irembo rya Yeshana, Irembo ry’Amafi, umunara wa Hananeli n’Umunara w’Amajana, gushika kw’Irembo ry’Intama. Bashitse kw’Irembo ry’Umurinzi barahagarara.
Ya migwi y’abaririmvyi yaririmba amashimwe iraheza ifata ibibanza vyayo mu Ngoro y’Imana; na jewe nyene mfata ikibanza ndi kumwe n’igice c’abanyacubahiro,
hamwe n’abaherezi, Eliyakimu, Mayaseya, Miniyamini, Mikaya, Eliyowenayi, Zakariya na Hananiya bafise inzamba zabo,
hamwe na Mayaseya, Shemaya, Eliyazeri, Uzi, Yehohanani, Malikiya, Elamu na Ezeri. Ya migwi iririmba indirimbo barongowe na Yezirahiya.

Maze kuri uwo musi batanga ibimazi bihambaye, banezerewe kuko Imana yari yabahaye umunezero mwinshi. Abagore n’abana na bo nyene baranezerwa, kandi umunezero wa Yerusalemu wumvikana gushika kure cane.

Muri ico gihe abagabo bari batoranijwe ngo bazezwe ivyumba vy’ububiko burimwo ivyeze imbere y’ibindi, ibigiracumi n’intererano. Bazana mu bubiko imigabane yategetswe mu Vyagezwe babikuye mu mirima ikikije ibisagara babizanira abaherezi n’Abalewi, kuko Abayuda bari bahimbawe n’uko ahaherezi n’Abalewi bari ku gikorwa cabo.
Bakora igikorwa c’Imana yabo n’igikorwa co guhumanura, nk’uko n’abaririmvyi n’abarinzi b’irembo na bo nyene bakoze, kandi nk’uko Dawidi n’umuhungu wiwe Salomo bari barategetse.
Mu bihe vya kera, mu bihe vya Dawidi na Asafu, hari abakuru b’abaririmvyi n’ab’indirimbo zo guhimbaza n’iz’ishimwe ku Mana.
Nuko mu misi ya Zerubabeli na Nehemiya, Abisirayeli bose baraterera ku musi ku musi imigabane y’abaririmvyi n’abarinzi b’irembo. Abalewi barategura kandi imigabane y’abakomoka kuri Aroni.
Kuri uwo musi igitabu ca Mose gisomerwa abantu, maze basanga handitswemwo ko ata Mwamoni canke Umunyamowabu azokwigera yemererwa kwinjira mw’ikoraniro ry’Imana,
kuko batasanganije Abisirayeli ivyokurya canke amazi, ahubwo baciye bahamagara Balamu ngo abavume. Ariko, Imana yacu ica ihindura uwo muvumo uba umuhezagiro.
Abantu bumvise ico cagezwe, baca basohora abanyamahanga b’ikivange bari mw’ikoraniro.
Imbere y’ivyo, Eliyashibu umuherezi yari yashinzwe kugenzura ivyumba vy’ububiko vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu. Yari afatanije cane na Tobiya,

kandi yari yamuhaye icumba kinini cahora kibikwamwo amashikanwa y’ibivuye mu ntete, ibimota neza n’ibikoresho bitandukanye vyo mu Ngoro. Kera ni ho habikwa kandi ibigiracumi vy’ifu, umutobe w’umuvinyu mushasha, amavuta yandikiwe Abalewi, abaririmvyi n’abarinzi b’amarembo, hamwe n’intererano zateguriwe abaherezi.
Ariko mu gihe ivyo vyariko biraba, jewe sinari i Yerusalemu, kuko mu mwaka wa mirongo itatu na kabiri Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma i Babiloni nari nasubiye ku mwami. Haheze igihe ndamusaba uruhusha,
nca ngaruka i Yerusalemu. Maze nca menya ibibi Eliyashibu yari yakoze mu guha icumba Tobiya mu rugo rw’Ingoro y’Imana.
Birambabaza cane nca nterera hanze ibintu vyose vyari ivya Tobiya ndabikura muri ico cumba.
Ntegeka ko bahumanura ivyo vyumba, maze nca nsubiza muri vyo ibikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu n’ibimota neza.
Namenye kandi ko ivyari vyaragerewe Abalewi batabihabwa, kandi ko Abalewi bose n’abaririmvyi bajejwe igikorwa bari bisubiriye mu matongo yabo.
Nuko mbaza abakuru ndabakarira nti: “Ni kubera iki Ingoro y’Imana ititaweho?” Nca rero ndabakoranya ndabashira mu bibanza vyabo.
Abayuda bose bazana ibigiracumi vyabo vy’intete, umutobe musha w’umuvinyu n’amavuta mu bubiko.

Nshiraho Shelemiya umuherezi, Zadoki umwigisha w’Ivyanditswe, n’Umulewi yitwa Pedaya ngo bazezwe ububiko, na Hanani mwene Zakuri, Zakuri mwene Mataniya, ngo abafashe, kuko abo bagabo bari bazwi ko ari abizigirwa. Bari bajejwe kugaburira benewabo ivyatanzwe.
Uze unyibuke kuri ivyo, ewe Mana yanje, kandi ntuze uhanagure ivyo nakoze mu bwizigirwa ku bw’Ingoro yawe n’ibikorwa biyikorerwamwo.

Muri iyo misi mbona abagabo b’i Buyuda bagana mu bwato bw’inzabibu kw’Isabato, bongera binjiza ingano bakaziremeka ku ndogoba, hamwe n’umuvinyu, inzabibu, insukoni n’iyindi mizigo y’uburyo bwose. Kandi bazana ivyo vyose i Yerusalemu kw’Isabato. Nuko nca ndabagabisha ngo ntibagurishe ivyokurya kuri uwo musi.
Abantu bava i Tiro baba i Yerusalemu bazana ifi n’ubwoko bwose bw’ibidandazwa bakabigurishiriza i Yerusalemu kw’Isabato ku bantu b’i Buyuda.
Ntonganya abakuru b’i Buyuda, maze ndababwira nti: “Murabona ikibi muriko murakora mu guhumanya umusi w’Isabato?
Mbega ba sogokuruza banyu ntibakoze nk’ivyo, gushika aho Imana irekura ibi vyago kuri twebwe no kuri kino gisagara? None raba muriko muravyura ubundi burake ku Bisirayeli mu guhumanya Isabato.”

Igitutu kimaze gushika ku marembo y’i Yerusalemu imbere y’uko Isabato itangura, ntegeka ko inzugi zugarwa ntizugururwe Isabato idaheze. Nshiraho bamwe mu bantu banje ku marembo kugira ngo ntihagire umuzigo n’umwe winjizwa ku musi w’Isabato.
Abagura n’abagurisha ibidandazwa vy’ubwoko butandukanye bararaye inyuma y’i Yerusalemu rimwe canke kabiri.
Ariko ndababurira mvuga nti: “Ni kuki murara hanze inyuma y’uruzitiro? Nimwasubira gukora mutyo, nzoca ndabafata.” Kuva ico gihe ntibasubiriye kuza kw’Isabato.
Nca ntegeka Abalewi kwihumanura ngo bagende kurinda amarembo kugira ngo Isabato igume ari iyera. Uze unyibukire kuri ivyo na vyo, ewe Mana yanje, ungirire imbabazi nk’uko urukundo rwawe rwinshi ruri.
Vyongeye, muri iyo misi mbona abantu b’i Buyuda bari bararongoye abagore bo muri Ashidodi, muri Amoni n’i Mowabu.
Igice c’abana babo bavuga ururimi rw’i Ashidodi canke ururimi rw’ayandi mahanga, kandi batashobora kuvuga ururimi rw’Abayuda.

Ndabatatira ndabaturako umuvumo. Nkubita bamwe mu bagabo ndabakwega umushatsi. Ndabarahiza mw’izina ry’Imana ndavuga nti: “Ntimukwiye gushingira abakobwa banyu abahungu babo, canke ngo mushingire abahungu banyu abakobwa babo canke ngo mubagire abagore banyu.

Mbega si uko Salomo umwami w’Abisirayeli yacumuye? Mu mahanga menshi nta mwami yari ameze nka we. Yakundwa n’Imana cane, kandi Imana yamwimitse ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli bose, ariko yakwegewe mu vyaha n’abagore b’abanyamahangakazi.
None birabereye kwumva ko namwe muriko murakora icaha kingana gityo, mugatakaza ubwizigirwa ku Mana yacu mu kurongora abagore b’abanyamahangakazi?”
Umwe mu bahungu ba Yoyada mwene Eliyashibu umuherezi mukuru yari umukwe wa Sanibalati Umuhoroni. Maze ndamwigiza kure yanje.
Ubibuke, ewe Mana yanje, kuko bahumanije igikorwa c’ubuherezi, n’isezerano ry’ubuherezi n’iry’Abalewi.
Nuko mpumanura abaherezi n’Abalewi ndabatandukanya n’ikintu cose c’ikinyamahanga, nca ndabashinga ibikorwa, umwe wese igikorwa ciwe.
Nca nongera nshinga ko habaho kuzana amashikanwa y’inkwi mu bihe vyashinzwe, n’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi. Uze unyibukane imbabazi, ewe Mana yanje.
